1.consolidated_definition: El acto de reconocer, identificar a alguien por el parecido con la familia … “A ésa la saco yo en doquiera que la vea.” Meléndez Muñoz.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The act of recognizing or identifying someone by their resemblance to a family member; "I'd know her anywhere."
